translation_english: [00:00] Hello Sharma ji, this is Gupta speaking, from that Royal Pharma, from Gorakhpur, sir. factual_claims.claim: The speaker identifies himself as Gupta from Royal Pharma in Gorakhpur.
Amoxclav and Azithro have not been arriving for almost three weeks.
The Lucknow C&F says there is no stock.
The new hospital placed an order which is short by six items.
The September anti-infective order was given to another company.
Circulars are being sent for a 10+2 scheme.
New parties from Prayagraj and Varanasi are reporting the same issue.
